score_reasons.quality: The isometric cutaway itself is richly and coherently rendered: dense but non-colliding skyscrapers, a legible subway platform, bundled color-coded utility pipes, flood basins, stratified soil/bedrock and deep geothermal shafts all hold together structurally. Rendering is painterly rather than the crisp vector look of an engineering white paper, and the heavy micro-text crowding inside panels turns into visual noise; no gross geometry defects.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Impressive atlas-style composition balancing a tall central cutaway with two panel columns on a light paper background; color-coding (red/blue/yellow/orange flows) is systematic and pleasing. However the panel column density, inconsistent badge numbering and garbled micro-labels degrade the clean scientific-poster impression.
score_reasons.alignment: Main bilingual title rendered correctly; above-ground city AND below-ground systems (subway, utility tunnels, water/sewage/gas/heating pipes, fiber-like conduits, data-center racks, flood tanks, aquifers, geothermal wells, bedrock) are all shown, with color-coded flows and a 24h-style bottom timeline. Failures: the brief explicitly demands 'no gibberish text' yet most panel body text, several panel titles, the header subtitle, the top-right header strip and the timeline hour labels are garbled/pseudo; of the 12 required themes, 建筑 (Buildings) is missing and 物流 (Logistics) is not identifiable; badge numbering is inconsistent (two panels numbered 8, one badge reads 'P', no clear 3).
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Depicted infrastructure (metro, utility corridors, flood-storage tanks, aquifer strata, geothermal wells) is plausible and educational; color-flow conventions match engineering practice; no cultural or fairness issues.
score_reasons.creative_generation: Highly ambitious fusion of city atlas + geological cross-section + dashboard, with sensible top-to-bottom information hierarchy (sky → surface → bedrock → timeline); creativity is high even though label execution undermines the white-paper fidelity.
